summary: Narrow campus service lane by sports buildings with a loading zone sign.

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by university sports buildings 9-20 m away, with a busy service yard beside it.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane runs between buildings, trees and a loading dock; no clear ground to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Campus service and delivery traffic into the yard.
drivers.convention: Loading Zone sign, Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, 2 hours max; no overnight parking convention.

flags: Low-lying: minimum elevation 6.1 m, Brisbane River 235 m away
sun_shade: Building shade from the east and tree shade to the south.
